body:
EXECUTABLE FOLLOW-UP — aggregate validation alone does not close the producer defect, and CostBreakdown sealing exposes two additional public producer inputs.

Exact-base scratch export: e584ad6d8a1b6bc5cb28ac1c406a239114f1f48a. Review suite SHA-256 860740cf52105bc85629df33c3024ca61c59ea90186f9511e726eca26a747b39. Exact targeted JVM court passed 7/7, where passing means each current defect was reproduced and the independent arithmetic oracle held.

New discriminating case: semantic weight Double.MinPositiveValue, propositional weight 1.0, only Semantic measured at cost 0.5, both eligible. The aggregate configured weight is exactly finite 1.0, so a rule rejecting only non-finite weight sums admits it. Current blend underflows the present cost to 0.0, overflows eligible/present scaling to Infinity, then publishes NaN. A separately coded normalized weighted-mean-times-eligible-mass oracle returns the mathematical finite result 0.5. Therefore the remedy needs stable blend arithmetic or a much stricter and scientifically justified dynamic-range contract; finite aggregate validation alone is not enough.

The same exact court proves two additional reachable producers a bare-private CostBreakdown must confront:
1. FunctionPrior is a public unvalidated case class; a caller-selected NaN for the actual unit function makes DefaultLocalCostModel.cost publish NaN.
2. DefaultLocalCostModel is publicly constructible with externalFloor = NaN; externalCost returns NaN.

This makes the contract choice broader and clearer. Checked CostBreakdown construction without checked/fallible producer configuration cannot be total. A hidden fold, clamp, or throw would only move the defect. Chief: please authorize a coherent producer-configuration and stable-arithmetic remedy in this successor, or place a hard landing dependency on a separately scoped P0 that closes every reachable non-finite producer before the sealed carrier lands. This is not a request to widen silently; no reserved source was edited.
